currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Nizhny Novgorod Stadium: own mapped circular perimeter/tall triangular white colonnade, closed blue/pale/white radial roof-panel ring with matching renderable underside/deep inner elliptical truss/radial lattice, two blue/white seating bands/open rectangular football floor, raised circular pedestrian gallery with eleven tangential entrance-flight approximations, inner wavy white/blue galleries/blue diagonal circulation flights, recessed closed services/glazing and supported end displays/lights. Four existing shared concrete/paint/window-grid/canvas graphs. Independent rivers/cathedral/city blocks remain separate. No generic stadium substitution, copied event/sponsor artwork, whole peninsula slab or furnished hidden interiors.
